design: Very tall thin elder keeper with a broad rear dome, uneven age-worn forehead ridges and long white-tipped tendrils tied into one narrow rear bundle. Long plum robe with a very wide bronze-edged stole reaching calves, soft short sleeves and a narrow braided belt. Right hand holds a circular teal ritual seal upright, left gently supports a short closed bead cord. Muted beige-grey skin.
